name: epoch-td
description: Tower defense from the Stone Age to the Space Age in a single dependency-free HTML file.

scripts.test: npm run sim && npm run qa
scripts.lab:oracle-full: node balance-lab/golden/generate.js 2000 | cargo run --release --manifest-path balance-lab/Cargo.toml -- golden
scripts.lab:search-gates: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path balance-lab/Cargo.toml -- attack 4 128 1 && node balance-lab/check-report.js
scripts.lab:defender-gates: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path balance-lab/Cargo.toml -- defend 1 4 4 7 && node balance-lab/check-defender.js
scripts.lab:sensitivity-smoke: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path balance-lab/Cargo.toml -- sensitivity 12 1 4 20260719 25 && node balance-lab/check-sensitivity.js balance-lab/out/sensitivity-report.json 240
scripts.lab:sensitivity: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path balance-lab/Cargo.toml -- sensitivity 100000 34 2048 20260719 25 && node balance-lab/check-sensitivity.js balance-lab/out/sensitivity-report.json 2000000
scripts.lab:test: cargo test --manifest-path balance-lab/Cargo.toml && npm run lab:golden
